findings.message: The branch does not merge cleanly into the current origin/main (2e04f29c). origin/main has moved past base 92be0db4 through PR205, which changed record/proofs/chain.json and reformatted the rounds README table. `git merge-tree` reports a content conflict in work/rounds/README.md, at the R-0038 row added by this branch. The PR needs a rebase or merge before integration. After that, frozen install and the clean-checkout security_scan should run on the rebased commit, not on dfe96076.

The native gate is still unmeasured and the report says so. Exit 3 is SENSE_INSTANCE_CHAIN_DIGEST_MISMATCH:SR-0633d2afcf0126e7, with counts error=1 and pass=0, and the run stopped before the scan executed. The delivery report and validation-results.json both mark it 'refused before measurement' and claim no PASS. The record.md gates 'security-scan' and 'evidence-chain' stay open until the maestro's clean-checkout run, so R-0038 must not close on the npm audit alone.

The compatibility check holds. Framework packages moved together to 22.2.0 and no 22.1.x copies remain. @angular/build and @angular/cli stay at 22.1.6, and their compiler-cli, core, platform-browser, service-worker and ng-packagr peers are ^22.0.0, which 22.2.0 satisfies. @angular/ssr ^22.1.6 is an optional peer and is not installed. STYNX 1.5.3 Angular peers are >=22.0.0 <23. STYNX 1.5.3, DEVAI, TypeScript 6.0.3 and Node engines are unchanged. All six C1 overrides are kept, and the 15 new overrides are all scoped to a specific parent and version. The lockfile overrides block matches package.json. The lock delta is 18 versions removed and 16 added, all on the vulnerable paths.

The claims match the evidence. All 49 manifest sha256 values match the files on disk, with nothing unlisted. environment-source-hashes match the 9 dependency files at HEAD. audit-after.json.gz shows 0 at every severity, with 1070 dependencies, no ignore or auditConfig set, and dev dependencies included. audit-before had 27 vulnerabilities (2 critical, 12 high, 10 moderate, 3 low) across 26 IDs, none new or remaining. Frontend tests total 2+15+1551+2042+1172+611+5115 = 10508 passed, and 14+133 = 147 TODO are reported as TODO, not as passes. 25 consumer commands plus the UI and BOAT builds make the stated 27. app 144, DEVAI 198, law 56 and pin 8 all passed. The diff against the base touches no app code, tests, thresholds, proofs or historical artifacts. Its only files outside the manifests and lockfile are work/rounds/R-0038/**, the new work/campaigns/C-0004 campaign file and the README row.
